name: Muv-Luv Supplement
original_name: マブラヴ サプリメント
source:
Muv-Luv Supplement is fan disc that focuses on Muv-Luv Extra and wants to make up for the lack of Sumika and H.

It contains:

Sakura no Hana ga Saku Mae ni ~Muv-Luv After Episode~

Before the Sakura Trees Bloom is an after story to Sumika's route in Muv-Luv Extra, starting in February 2002, showing the events where Takeru, Sumika, Ayamine, Sakaki, Yoroi and Tama graduate from Hakuryou Academy.

Muv-Luv ~Another Episode Collection~

Also known as the Heroine Short Story Collection, it's a batch of short stories that take place prior to and during Extra, each one centered around one of the main heroines. They were later included in photonflowers. Contains the following stories:

* [i]Takeru-chan to Issho![/i] - story centered around [url=/c108]Kagami Sumika[/url]
* [i]Sono Na wa Takeru[/i] and [i]Waga Na wa Meiya[/i] - two stories centered around [url=/c104]Mitsurugi Meiya[/url]
* [i]Shirogane-kun Chotto![/i] - story centered around [url=/c115]Sakaki Chizuru[/url]
* [i]Shirogane... Tabeteru?[/i] - story centered around [url=/c123]Ayamine Kei[/url]
* [i]Takeru-san no Shippo[/i] - story centered around [url=/c130]Tamase Miki[/url]

Muv-Luv Duelist

Rumbling Angel is a trading card game sold by Silver Blitz. It features characters from various galge brands such as [url=/p4]Age[/url]. This is a PC adaptation of this game featuring the heroines of Muv-Luv.
It has a story mode that serves as a tutorial and also a free battle mode.

KimiNozo Radio Shucchouban 2

Accessories, wallpapers and voice collection

The latest trailer of [url=/v92]Muv-Luv Alternative[/url]

[Edited from the [url=https://muvluv.fandom.com/wiki/Muv-Luv_Supplement]Muv-Luv Fandom Wiki[/url]]
